# lemonPRESS / Another Clue

This is a crawler-oriented proof edition of an admitted literary work.

Canonical work id: lemonpress:another-clue
Edition: lemonpress:another-clue:crawler:001

Important distinctions:

- RETRIEVED != READ
- CHUNK != BOOK
- SOURCE != PROJECTION
- DESCENDANT != ANCESTOR

Primary carrier:
- works/another-clue/book.txt
